tagDefinitions.agent-instructions: The project authors skills or persistent agent instructions.
tagDefinitions.architecture: The work changes module boundaries or system structure.
tagDefinitions.bugfix: The project is debugging or correcting faulty behavior.
tagDefinitions.credentials: The work includes credentials, secrets, or human-only setup.
tagDefinitions.cutover: The project includes a migration or production cutover.
tagDefinitions.deployment: The project builds, releases, or deploys software.
tagDefinitions.infrastructure: The project operates hosts, networks, or cloud resources.
tagDefinitions.large-change: The work spans multiple sessions or dependent decisions.
tagDefinitions.mobile: The project targets a mobile application or mobile QA workflow.
tagDefinitions.expo: The project uses Expo application or release tooling.
tagDefinitions.maestro: The project uses Maestro for mobile QA.
tagDefinitions.prototype: The project needs a throwaway state, logic, or UI experiment.
tagDefinitions.provisioning: The project includes human-driven external service setup.
tagDefinitions.research: The project needs evidence gathered from primary sources.
tagDefinitions.saas: The project is a SaaS product or bootstrap project.
tagDefinitions.skills: The project creates or maintains agent skills.
tagDefinitions.typescript: The project contains TypeScript or JavaScript source.
tagDefinitions.ui-design: The project is exploring or changing user interface design.
tagDefinitions.unity: The project uses the Unity engine.
tagDefinitions.webapp: The project contains a web application.
tagDefinitions.adversarial-review: The work benefits from independent critical review or challenge.
tagDefinitions.agent-execution: The project uses agents to execute specs, tickets, triage, or handoffs.
tagDefinitions.automation: The work benefits from scripts, generators, codemods, or repeatable levers.
tagDefinitions.autonomy: The work should proceed on safe reversible steps without unnecessary human blocking.
tagDefinitions.code-understanding: The work needs codebase explanation, ownership mapping, or subsystem walkthroughs.
tagDefinitions.cursor: The source skill depends on Cursor-shaped orchestration or configuration.
tagDefinitions.debugging: The work investigates root causes or failing behavior.
tagDefinitions.design: The work shapes an interface, module, domain, or system design.
tagDefinitions.documentation: The project authors or maintains technical documentation.
tagDefinitions.domain-modeling: The work encodes domain concepts and language into software structure.
tagDefinitions.git: The work involves git history, merges, rebases, or review flow.
tagDefinitions.handoff: The work prepares continuity for another session or agent.
tagDefinitions.implementation: The work executes a prepared spec, ticket, or implementation brief.
tagDefinitions.issues: The work uses an issue tracker or issue-state workflow.
tagDefinitions.merge-conflict: The work resolves an in-progress merge or rebase conflict.
tagDefinitions.migration: The work converges code toward a new architecture or API.
tagDefinitions.parallel-work: The work benefits from parallel worker coverage or races.
tagDefinitions.planning: The work produces specs, tickets, plans, or decision artifacts.
tagDefinitions.readability: The work improves code clarity and reader load.
tagDefinitions.refactoring: The work restructures code without changing product behavior.
tagDefinitions.reliability: The work designs for retries, restarts, idempotency, or operational safety.
tagDefinitions.review: The work reviews code, design, plans, or implementation risk.
tagDefinitions.simplicity: The work should delete, flatten, or choose a smaller design before adding.
tagDefinitions.spec: The work turns conversation or intent into an executable specification.
tagDefinitions.subagents: The work uses independent agent workers or model reviewers.
tagDefinitions.tdd: The work should follow a red-green-refactor test-first loop.
tagDefinitions.testing: The work needs tests, TDD, or verification-driven implementation.
tagDefinitions.tickets: The work decomposes plans into independently grabbable issues.
tagDefinitions.triage: The work classifies, verifies, and briefs incoming issues or PRs.
tagDefinitions.types: The work uses static types to encode constraints and prevent invalid states.
tagDefinitions.workflow: The work defines repeatable agent or developer workflows.
tagDefinitions.writing: The work creates or edits prose intended for humans or agents.
tagDefinitions.orchestration: The work benefits from fan-out, multiple passes, or delegated agents.
